ChildMinutesLst.Title: b. Avid Contract Amendment
ChildMinutesLst.Minutes: Approve the AVID quote and amended contract to move forward with the learning and deployment of AVID to include Belvidere Elementary, Butcher-Greene Elementary, Conn-West Elementary, and Meadowmere Elementary. Grandview Middle School, Martin City K8, and Grandview High School are on the original contract and will remain.  The additional expense is not to exceed $54,051.00 for the 2026-2027 school year.
